home.title: Igisubizo kiguma ku ipaji mwahawe.
home.body: Baza mu Cyongereza cyangwa mu Kinyarwanda. Umwarimu akoresha inyigisho z'ishuri kandi agaragaza ipaji.
home.previewAnswer: Kuraho 5 ku mpande zombi, hanyuma ugabanye na 3. Itandukaniro ni 5.
home.featureCiteBody: Igisubizo cy'ukuri kigaragaza igitabo n'ipaji byakomotseho.
home.featureHintBody: Umunyeshuri ashobora kubona icyitegererezo imbere y'uko igisubizo cyose kigaragazwa.
home.featureLanguageBody: Ibisobanuro bimwe bishobora gusabwa mu rurimi urwo arirwo rwose.
home.step1Body: Kode y'ishuri, izina ry'ukoresha, n'ijambo ry'ibanga. Umunyeshuri ntagomba imeyili.
home.step3Body: Fungura inyandiko iri iruhande rw'igisubizo urebe ipaji.
home.footer: Ku mashuri yisumbuye yo mu Rwanda.

gate.title: Injira kugira ngo ukomeze
gate.body: Amasomo, isomero, n'ibiganiro by'abanyeshuri bifunguka nyuma yo kwinjira ukoresheje ishuri ryawe.

desk.title: Umurimo wawe
desk.studentBody: Komeza isomo, fungura igitabo, cyangwa ukore intambwe ikurikira.
desk.teacherBody: Fungura iklasi usome ikiganiro igihe ishuri ribyemera.
desk.adminBody: Injiza igitabo, suzuma konti, uhitemo modeli.
desk.empty: Nta somo rirabaho. Ritangire igihe igice kiri imbere yawe.

login.title: Injira
login.body: Koresha kode y'ishuri n'izina ry'ukoresha wahawe.
login.failed: Ishuri, izina, cyangwa ijambo ry'ibanga si byo.

learn.title: Amasomo
learn.body: Buri somo rifite ikiganiro cyaryo, ibyitegererezo, n'ibisubizo bifite inkomoko.
learn.emptyBody: Ita izina ku nsanganyamatsiko ubaze ku gice wahawe.
learn.modalBody: Ita izina ku nsanganyamatsiko. Ikibazo cya mbere kiza umaze kwinjira.
learn.name: Izina ry'isomo

chat.sourcesBody: Izi paji zarakusanyijwe ku gisubizo giheruka.
chat.empty: Baza ikibazo ku gice wahawe. Igisubizo kigaragaza ipaji.

chapters.title: Isomero
chapters.body: Ibitabo ishuri ryinjije. Dosiye ite guye ishobora gukoreshwa mu isomo.
chapters.emptyBody: Umuyobozi ashobora kwinjiza PDF ku ipaji y'ishuri.

sequences.title: Intambwe
sequences.body: Intambwe zayobowe. Ikibazo kimwe, hanyuma ukomeze.

teacher.title: Amaklasi
teacher.body: Hitamo iklasi, hanyuma ufungure ikiganiro cy'umunyeshuri.
teacher.transcriptsOff: Iri shuri ntiryemereye abarimu gusoma ibiganiro.

admin.title: Ishuri
admin.body: Amadosiye y'inyigisho, modeli y'ibisubizo, na konti.
admin.uploadBody: Dosiye ibikwa ku ishuri ikategurirwa gushakisha.
admin.providerBody: Hitamo uwandika ibisubizo. Gushakisha gukomeza gukoresha ibitabo byanyu.
admin.name: Izina

settings.title: Igenamiterere
settings.body: Izina n'ururimi bigaragara ku masomo yawe, n'ijambo ry'ibanga rya iyi konti.
settings.name: Izina rigaragara
settings.changeBody: Nibura inyuguti 10, kandi ijambo ry'ibanga ntirigomba kuba rifite izina ry'ukoresha.
